description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, a part of an Android application used to display detailed information about a content item such as a TV show or movie. It manages UI elements including background, metadata, action buttons, and handles network requests to initiate media playback. The class also manages user interactions, focus navigation with D-PAD, and animations for focus changes.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information including metadata, actions, and playback functionality.

classes.name: ButtonConfig
classes.description: A data class representing configuration for action buttons, including label and icon resource.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, populates content data, and prepares action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Displays current system date and time in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Fills UI with content metadata obtained from intent extras or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Configures focusable action buttons, icons, and click listeners.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates the focus transition for action buttons (scale, translation, elevation).

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Triggers corresponding actions based on button pressed (play, schedule, record, etc.).

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles D-PAD navigation and Enter/Center key presses for focus movement and activation.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Performs an API call to retrieve media URL and starts playback activity with that URL.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses server response JSON or direct URL string to extract media URL.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a well-formed HTTP URL.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Static factory method to generate an intent for launching ContentInfoActivity with content data.
